Branches: main (merged pull requests, signed by GitHub)
one per cell: <env>-sl-az1, <env>-sl-az2, …
moved only by the release pipeline

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pull request
CI validates (kustomize build, kubeconform,
policy tests) → merge = the signed commit
promotion dev → acc → prd is a pull request too

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stateful deployment pipeline
self-hosted agent · workload identity federation
checkout + verify signature → policy gate → kubectl diff
→ approval → server-side apply → rollout checks
